messages:
Maya: quick Q — after shifting 10% to fallback-quantized, p95 for /v1/generate jumped ~220ms; p50 barely moved, p99 moved more. sample count looked stable. artifact or attribution bug?

Devin: are the sample counts from the same rollup origin? endpoint-level rollups drop variant/routing tags, so merged quantiles can be misleading.

Sanjay: saw similar Friday. quantized path samples lower. merging percentiles without provenance causes odd jumps when weights change.

Maya: console logs show route=generate variant=quantized, but percentiles widget is endpoint-level only. no variant breakdown by default.

Jorge: paste dashboard query? tdigest merge vs histogram behavior could explain.

Maya: p95 query: quantile_over_time(0.95, latency_ms{endpoint="/v1/generate"}[5m]) — no route/variant tag.

Devin: exact issue: merged tdigest blobs lacking sample provenance mean small weight shifts can non-linearly move percentiles.

Sanjay: tdigest merges depend on input shapes; if one shard has many short requests and another few long tails, p95 jumps when weight moves.

Lee: note: ingest rollup drops routing_policy metadata to control cardinality (sample_origin="ingest"). tradeoff favored performance; maybe too lossy for percentiles.

Maya: options: 1) keep low-cardinality rollups + show warning on weight shifts; 2) surface per-variant percentiles (expensive); 3) attach small provenance pill to percentiles showing sample-count split by variant.

Jorge: prefer 3 — small pill next to p95: "origin: merged (n=12.1k)" with expand for counts by variant and quick "show by variant" action.

Devin: backend change: add compact provenance map to tdigest rollups with sample_counts_by_variant so UI can show sensitivity without storing full high-card series. proto sketch: message Rollup { bytes tdigest = 1; map<string,int64> sample_counts_by_variant = 2; }

Sanjay: also consider including last_rollout_weights + timestamp to flag recent weight shifts automatically.

Maya: who owns rollup proto? @Devin. Also need console docs blurb for SLO owners about "sample-count stability".

Devin: i'll take proto + PR. aggregator will populate counts map. add toggle for teams to opt into full per-variant rollups.

Lee: ops concern: cardinality spike risk. provenance map is middle ground; full per-variant across endpoints would be costly. I'll estimate costs after PR.

Jorge: UX: when route weights changed within N minutes show orange badge on percentile: "percentile sensitive to recent routing changes" with docs link and "show by variant" quick action.

Maya: +1. add console quick-query "Show percentile by variant" that runs split when provenance present.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: telemetry-rollup-provenance v1 -> staging

Devin: PR plan: proto, aggregator populate map, UI read map. if provenance missing show "provenance unavailable".

Maya: please add short console doc: "Interpreting p50/p95/p99 when routing or quota policies change" with before/after example.

Sanjay: i'll draft the blurb post-PR with numbers + tiny ascii diagram.

Maya: actions: Devin - proto & PR; Lee - cost impact; Jorge - pill & tooltip mock; Sanjay - doc. tagging @Devin @Lee @Jorge @Sanjay

Lee: noted, will do back-of-envelope then refine.

Maya: thanks, i'll follow up with screenshot and routing timeline.
